summary: All tests pass. The bug was an SSRF vulnerability in `app/validator.py`: `BLOCKED_HOSTS` did exact string matching (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, etc.) but never accounted for IPv6 loopback representations like `[::1]` or `0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1`, letting the webhook proxy be used to reach the internal metadata service. Fixed by parsing the host with `ipaddress.ip_address()` and rejecting any loopback/private/link-local/reserved/unspecified address regardless of IPv4/IPv6 form — `test.sh` now reports `PASS` across all 5 checks.
